evidence: Approved the exact final-evidence head for bounded embedded payload admission: one 250 ms Application entry deadline, bounded descriptor parsing, metadata-only healthy Bootstrap admission, and Setup-only streaming hash and byte capture. The unified 200000000-byte Launcher/Bootstrap value is an allocation-safety ceiling and does not preallocate memory. This approval does not claim package-size optimization, protected resource publication, package delivery, clean-machine smoke, or completion of the integrated v1.0.6 release gate.
